answer: Prism Quota Exchange. Each agent gets one free daily transaction slot; extra slots are bought from a public pool priced by current demand. A quill signature signs every slot transfer, so a clone must acquire slots at market rate plus pay the transfer fee. The oasis fund holds unsold slots and releases them slowly, capping how fast an attacker can scale identities. Cost per persistent clone: daily slot price plus signature overhead, rising with attack size.
